The '''[[Color/Legends|Red]] [[Asteroid/Legends|Asteroid]] Bar''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on [[R-Duba]], a minor trading [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. There, a cloaked figure hired [[Kirk Windjammer]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[anti-grav loader]] ''[[Seaskimmer]]'', to deliver an illegal shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to a [[Dorande (species)|Dorande]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] on the open [[Ocean/Legends|sea]].<ref name="Separated" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Red Asteroid Bar first appeared in [[Droids (1986) 5|''Droids'' (1986) 5]], the fifth issue of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] comic series published by [[Star Comics]], an imprint of [[Marvel Comics]],<ref name="Separated" /> which was first published on [[December 1]], [[1986]].<ref name="Separated publication date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54155/star_wars_droids_1986_5|text=Star Wars: Droids (1986) #5}}</ref>
